text.p: These are the main stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Five Unita generals, including military chief Arlindo Chenda Ben Ben arrived in the Angolan capital for integration into the Angolan Armed Forces.
- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos met Paul Hare, a special U.S. envoy sent to Luanda by U.S. President Bill Clinton, to discuss delays in Angola's peace process.

- The vice governor for defence in Angola's northern Cabinda enclave, Henrique Futi, said the military situation in the region remained stable after a ceasefire between the Angolan government and separatist guerrillas.
